sourceRepairsApplied.from: 施特拉德並不認為鴉人是一個嚴重的威脅，但是萊薩迦將他們視作了能夠威脅到她的存在。在經過了大量的調查和研究後，萊薩迦在美酒巫師莊園（見第 12 章）發現了一個鴉人庇護所，隨後她掀起了針對它的戰爭。另外，她與在往日山丘出沒的瘋狂德魯伊們結為了同盟，讓他們相信是她誕下了史垂德——那個被他們視若神明的存在。透過獲得這群德魯伊的協助，她希望能夠徹底清除巴洛維亞的鴉人威脅。
sourceRepairsApplied.to: 史特拉德不認為鴉人是嚴重威脅，但萊薩迦選擇將他們視為眼中釘。經過長期搜索與探知，她在美酒巫師酒莊（第12章）發現一處鴉人庇護所，並開始對其發動戰爭。此外，她與出沒於往日山丘（第14章）的瘋狂德魯伊結盟，說服他們相信史特拉德是她所生，而德魯伊將史特拉德視為神祇。有德魯伊相助，她期望徹底清除巴洛維亞的鴉人禍患。

numericEquivalentDifferences.english: Asteria hasn't aged since Istus drew her future from the first Deck of Many Things. She doesn't know why this is but surmises her life is tied to that deck; so long as it continues to exist, so will she. She has no way to prove this hypothesis, but she nevertheless opposes groups like the Grim Harrow (see chapter 19) that seek to destroy the {@i Deck of Many Things}.
numericEquivalentDifferences.localized: 自從伊斯圖絲從第一副永珍無常牌中描繪出她的未來後，阿斯忒瑞亞就沒有衰老。她不知道為什麼會這樣，但她猜測她的生命已經與牌組相連；只要它繼續存在，她就會繼續存在。雖然她沒有辦法證明這個假設，但她仍然反對像死懼刑徒（見第十九章）這樣試圖摧毀{@i 永珍無常牌}的團體。
numericEquivalentDifferences.reason: Arabic and written-number/fraction forms are equivalent

numericEquivalentDifferences.english: Aurnozci's lair is a layer of the Abyss called Xulregg. See chapter 20 for details about this realm.
numericEquivalentDifferences.localized: 奧諾茨的巢穴是無底深淵中的一個位層，名為敘勒戈。關於這個位面的細節，請參閱第二十章。
numericEquivalentDifferences.reason: Arabic and written-number/fraction forms are equivalent

numericEquivalentDifferences.english: Only a Wish spell can end Augustus's curse. He has ordered Wanewort, a night hag, to find anyone with access to that spell and plans to offer anything in his power in exchange for undoing his curse. And if bargaining doesn't work, there's always blackmail. (See the " Using the Moonstalkers in Your Campaign " section in chapter 11 for more details.)
numericEquivalentDifferences.localized: 只有祈願術才能結束奧古斯都的詛咒。他已經命令衰草，一名夜鬼婆去尋找任何可以使用該法術的人，並計劃用自己力所能及的任何東西來交換解除他的詛咒。而要是靠講價行不通，那他也不會吝惜於敲詐勒索。（見第十一章"在戰役中使用月之潛獵者"部分獲取更多細節。）

numericEquivalentDifferences.english: When she retired from adventuring, Euryale relocated to Cair Ophidian, a small hideaway in the Outlands detailed later in chapter 22. There, Euryale embraced the quiet life of a gardener, and she spends her time tending to the plants she's cultivated around her home. However, should Asteria call for her aid, Euryale would venture across the multiverse without hesitation, battling tooth and nail to protect her sister.
numericEquivalentDifferences.localized: 當她從冒險中退休時，尤瑞艾莉搬到了蛇之家Cair Ophidian，一個位於外域的小型藏身之處，其細節將在第二十二章稍後詳細介紹。在那裡，尤瑞艾莉過著園丁的平靜生活，她把時間都花在照料自己在家周圍種植的植物上。然而，如果阿斯忒瑞亞需要她的援助術，尤瑞艾莉會毫不猶豫地冒險穿越多元宇宙，竭盡全力保護她的姐妹。
numericEquivalentDifferences.reason: Arabic and written-number/fraction forms are equivalent

numericEquivalentDifferences.localized: 死懼刑徒——一夥由永珍無常牌（見第十九章）創造的不死生物——會尋找苦刑獵鷹，捕獲它們並將其訓練為獵獸。死懼刑徒從衰朽花園中派出這些不死同伴，以搜尋永珍無常牌。在苦難尋獵中，苦刑獵鷹會為獵物偵察並伴隨死懼刑徒參與戰鬥。

numericEquivalentDifferences.localized: 熾天之壁（見第十章）和死懼刑徒（見第十九章）都知曉洗牌妖以及它們對永珍無常牌的狂熱痴情，這些組織時刻警惕著這些精類生物的出現，因為那通常意味著附近有一副無常牌。

numericEquivalentDifferences.localized: 許多學者認為，利爪裂法獸、利爪星座（見第十三章）以及永珍無常牌中的禽爪卡之間存在著某種聯絡，但並不清楚其中哪一個才是最先出現的。這張卡牌——會摧毀抽到它的任何人擁有的所有魔法物品——可能是以這種野獸的名字命名的，或者反過來。

numericEquivalentDifferences.reason: Arabic and written-number/fraction forms are equivalent

numericEquivalentDifferences.english: Izek has dreams of Ireena. If he spots her, he tries to take her by force to the burgomaster's mansion. Izek covets her in an unwholesome way and won't allow anyone or anything to come between them.
numericEquivalentDifferences.localized: 艾澤克一直夢到伊麗娜。如果他發現了伊麗娜，他會試圖強行把她帶去鎮長府邸。如果他成功了，他會將她作為俘虜關押在自己的臥室裡（第五章，區域 N3j）。艾澤克和伊麗娜不知道的是他們其實是兄妹。伊麗娜在艾澤克被恐狼攻擊後逃走，在森林裡迷了路。在震驚中她遊蕩了好幾天，直到被巴洛維亞村子裡的考利安·英迪洛維奇村長髮現並收養。艾澤克以一種不健康的方式覬覦著她，不允許任何人或任何東西介入他們之間。

numericEquivalentDifferences.english: Rahadin, the dusk elf chamberlain of Castle Ravenloft, has served Strahd's family faithfully for nearly five hundred years. He is Strahd's eternal servant, a longtime comrade-in-arms, and a ruthless warrior who has killed thousands in his lifetime.
numericEquivalentDifferences.localized: 黃昏精靈拉哈丁是鴉閣城堡的總管，他已經忠心耿耿地服侍了施特拉德家族將近 500 年之久。他是施特拉德永遠的僕人、長久而可靠的戰友，同時也是一名奪走上千人性命的鐵血戰士。
numericEquivalentDifferences.reason: five hundred is faithfully rendered as 500

numericEquivalentDifferences.english: The half-elf ringmaster is, in fact, a legendary human vampire hunter named Rudolph van Richten. Van Richten's tale is a sad one. A scholar and doctor from a land called Darkon, he married his childhood sweetheart, Ingrid, and together they had a son, Erasmus. When he was fourteen, Erasmus was stolen away by Vistani and sold to a vampire named Baron Metus to be used as a companion. By the time van Richten found his son, it was too late: the baron had already transformed Erasmus into a vampire spawn. Erasmus begged his father to end his suffering, which van Richten did by pounding a wooden stake through his son's chest. Baron Metus avenged that deed by killing van Richten's wife, and van Richten has lived with the horror of his family's destruction ever since. After destroying Baron Metus in turn, van Richten sought revenge against the Vistani and took up a life of hunting evil monsters.
numericEquivalentDifferences.localized: 這名半精靈馬戲班班主其實是一位名叫魯道夫·範·裡希騰的傳奇人類吸血鬼獵人。他的過往充滿悲傷。他是一名來自達孔地方的學者和醫生，與他的青梅竹馬的戀人英格麗德 Ingrid 結為夫婦併產下一子，名叫伊拉斯謨 Erasmus。伊拉斯謨在 14 歲時被維斯塔尼人偷走了，並被賣給了一位名叫米特斯男爵 Baron Metus 的吸血鬼，以和他做伴。當範·裡希騰最終找到他的兒子的時候，一切已經太晚了，男爵已經把伊拉斯謨轉化成了初生吸血鬼。伊拉斯謨乞求自己的父親終結他所受的折磨，最終範·裡希騰只能將一隻木樁釘穿他兒子的胸膛來滿足兒子的心願。作為報復，米特斯男爵將範·裡希騰的妻子殘忍殺害，自此範·裡希騰始終被家破人亡的恐懼所折磨著。在最終，範·裡希騰以牙還牙、以眼還眼地消滅了米特斯男爵，隨後開始了對維斯塔尼人的復仇，並投入一生來狩獵邪惡的怪物。

tagShapeDifferencesResolved.english: The jermlaine's skin is rough, leathery, and textured like stone. Part of the jermlaine's anger comes from attempts to hunt them down and fashion cloaks and other material from their skin. Such experiments have yet to yield a functional magic item, and the jermlaine's hatred of outsiders is driven in part by their assumption that any who meet them seek to harvest them for such experiments.

tagShapeDifferencesResolved.english: The Curse of Wandering is the greatest danger of the desert lands. Most of these former humanoids are mindless marauders, though some tales speak of {@creature Amonkhet mummy|PSA|mummies} that have retained a sinister intelligence and even magical ability, becoming {@creature Amonkhet mummy lord|PSA|mummy lords}.
